software_class: server-side API, integration service, or distributed backend system

options.name: Modular API service
options.when_to_use: One deployable service can own the required domain boundary.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when independent deployment boundaries are proven.
options.rationale: Keeps API delivery simple and observable.
options.tradeoffs: Internal modules need discipline to avoid coupling.
options.risks: Boundaries can erode as features accumulate.

options.name: Event-driven service set
options.when_to_use: Workflows require asynchronous coordination or durable events.
options.rationale: Improves decoupling and resilience for workflows.
options.risks: Event schemas can drift without governance.

options.name: Microservice system
options.when_to_use: Independent teams or scaling boundaries are explicit.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when a modular service is sufficient.
